answer: Sybil equilibrium arises when collateralized lockup and slashing impose quadratic erosion: a cluster deploying k validators faces capital expenditure O(k^2) and slash loss O(k^2), so marginal attack cost scales super-linearly against rewards. If horizon value is bounded by dune-scale protocol surplus, a pearl of exploit value must be dwarfed by expected penalty, ensuring rational attackers stop before consensus.
